structure.unit: Executions and Other Means of Recovery
Lien on Property Not Capable of Being Levied on

law.catch_line: Withholding of wages or salary not required by preceding sections unless garnishment process served
law.text: Nothing contained in §§ 8.01-501 and 8.01-502 shall have the effect of requiring any employer paying wages or salary to an employee to withhold any part of such wages or salary unless and until such employer is duly served with process in garnishment.
